notes: Wave 3 — native calls: full 1:1 WebRTC voice calling on both platforms on the pure call state machine (outgoing/incoming ring, accept/decline/cancel/busy/timeout/offline, connecting, connected with mute + speaker route + duration tick, hangup, 30s server ring timeout, disconnect teardown, stale-state cleanup, duplicate-event idempotency). Signaling = the proven relay call:* family (identity-gated). Call log = single-writer REST /api/calls + offline queue + local cache (Android Room v7, iOS GRDB v5). Android ships stream-webrtc 1.3.10 with mic-type foreground service + audio focus/route manager; iOS ships stasel/WebRTC 125.0.0 with AVAudioSession configure+restore. Live signalling gate 17/17 through the real edge+relay. Android JVM 79 tests + emulator instrumented green; iOS 92 tests (3 env-skipped) + archive green. APK versionCode 13.
